persona.who: Someone who only uses a phone: Kayla, the electrician from the earlier runs. Self employed Starter on a Samsung phone.
persona.bio: Kayla, 27, electrician who owns a one truck business in Phoenix. She is in attics by 7am and on job sites all day; she has no office and works from her Samsung phone in the truck. The paperwork around the job is what drags: writing quotes, sending invoices, texting homeowners about times, chasing payment, asking for reviews, and keeping the truck stocked with breakers, wire and fittings so she doesn't run to the supply house mid job. She does quotes on her phone at night, often by talking them through. She tried ChatGPT once to write a review request and forgot about it.
